name: Real-CUGAN 2× (conservative)
description: Doubles manga and anime images while keeping the original texture; the safest choice.

name: Real-CUGAN 2× (strong denoise)
description: Doubles images and removes heavy JPEG noise; good for low-quality scans.

name: Real-CUGAN 4× (conservative)
description: Quadruples small images; slower, for low-resolution pages.

name: waifu2x CUnet 2× (light denoise)
description: The classic anime-art upscaler, doubling images with light noise reduction.

name: Anime4K 2× (small)
description: Doubles comic pages on the graphics card; the quickest, for phones.

name: Anime4K 2× (medium)
description: Doubles comic pages on the graphics card, sharper than the small one.

name: Anime4K 2× (large)
description: Doubles comic pages on the graphics card; for computers.

name: Anime4K 2× (very large)

name: Anime4K line restore (small)

name: Anime4K line restore (medium)
description: Cleans up blurred lines and compression artefacts, more thoroughly.

name: Anime4K soft restore (medium)
description: Smooths compression artefacts gently, keeping the drawing's softness.
